amendments.text:
The following airspeed limitations shall be shown on placards in view of the

pilot: (a) Maximum speed with landing gear extended, if the airplane is equipped with retractable landing gear. (b) Minimum control speed with one engine inoperative, for multiengine airplanes. [(c) Rough air or maneuvering speed determined in accordance with Sec. 3.741. ] AIRPLANE FLIGHT MANUAL
